# Error #88: SenderTransferNotFound

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#88`
- **Variant Name**: `SenderTransferNotFound`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `WARNING`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::SenderTransferNotFound` — no sender-transfer proposal is stored for the stream.

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Propose a sender transfer first; `accept_sender_transfer` and `expire_sender_transfer` require a stored proposal for that stream.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#19-consented-sender-role-transfer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#19-consented-sender-role-transfer)
